title: HYRR impact-classified release notes
description: Human-reviewed, machine-readable release notes derived from CHANGELOG.md at release time. Answers `would my previous answer have been wrong?` for a scientific-tool user. See #572.

releases.description: Releases in newest-first order. Ordering is checked at release time.

version.description: SemVer (matches release-please tag minus the leading v).

data_version.description: nucl-parquet DATA_VERSION shipped in this release (CalVer YYYY.M.MICRO). A data-only bump can change results with zero code change, invisible in a commit-derived changelog.

summary.description: User-facing one-liner. NOT a commit subject — should answer 'what would I compute differently now?'.

impact.description: Class of change. `physics_affecting` MUST be conservative — when unsure, mark it affecting. `silent_failure_fixed` = the fix removes a wrong-answer-without-warning; `data_update` = nuclear data bump; `api_change` = tool signature / behaviour visible to callers; `ux` = client-visible convenience with no numerical impact; `internal` = plumbing.

silent.description: true = a user running the earlier version would have gotten a wrong answer with NO error, warning or log line. This is the load-bearing distinction — a visible error is a stopped experiment; a silent wrong number is bad science published.

affected.description: MCP tool names whose output could differ. `["*"]` = all tools. Empty array = no user-visible surface changed (internal/CI/etc.).

guidance.description: Actionable one-paragraph guidance an agent can relay verbatim — what to re-run, what was silently wrong, what to check.
